remark:
• WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter is deprecated in recent Spring Security versions; consider defining a SecurityFilterChain @Bean instead.  
• In-memory passwords should use a PasswordEncoder in production (noop is acceptable for demonstration only).  
• If you serve static resources or Swagger UI, you may need additional ResourceHandlerRegistry or WebMvcConfigurer methods.  
• CORS settings may be externalized to application properties or global config for finer control.
